QuestInfo.name: Mountain Turtle Breeding Season
QuestInfo.0: Alicia went to the mountain to search for animals for the Ark. Before you could follow her, you met a soldier, who asked for your assistance in securing rations.
QuestInfo.1: The soldier needs your help to gather Mountain Turtle Eggs for rations. Hunt Mountain Turtles on Snowy Mountain 1 and collect their eggs.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered plenty of Mountain Turtle Eggs.
